spans.text: Some would argue that this is a defining feature of Hinduism.}} The word Hindu is an exonym, and while Hinduism has been called the oldest surviving religion in the world, it is also described since the 19th century by the term Sanātana Dharma ().

The word Hindū is an Endonym and exonymexonym,; derived from the Sanskrit word Sindhu,; the name of the Indus River as well as the country of the lower Indus basin (Sindh).; It is frequently being used in the Rigveda.
